# DeepSteer

> PyTorch library to monitor, measure, and steer alignment from LLM pretraining through post-training: layer activations, concept directions, their geometry and reliability, and ablation and steering, on real HuggingFace models.

DeepSteer measures how language models represent moral content and whether their decisions and actions follow it. It hooks real HuggingFace models (`WhiteBoxModel`), collects layer activations, extracts concept directions (mean-difference, LEACE, probe weights), checks their reliability and geometry (cosine matrices, permutation tests, participation ratio with nulls), and tests them causally with ablation and steering sweeps. Install with `pip install deepsteer` (Python 3.10+, alpha API; each subpackage's `__all__` is its public surface). Agents writing code against the library should read the consumer skill first: it gives the data conventions, exact signatures and the validity gates.
